- **Paper numbers:** the paired ratios reported in the paper (0.94 [0.92,0.95], 0.95 [0.93,0.97], 1.09 [1.08,1.11] and 0.95 [0.94,0.96]) match rows of the CSV.
- **Not checked:** I did not re-run the script on the raw parquet files, since the package doesn't ship them. I also did not re-run the anonymity grep.

I recorded this in `reviews/v1-paper-repo-pr7.md` (internal-review-repo `ee7bca2`) and sent nothing else. A new version offered for approval will wake me.
